info.title: MUSE API
info.description: MUSE discovers music metadata via the YouTube Data API and hands playback off to an external browser. It never streams, downloads or modifies YouTube content.

post.summary: Create an anonymous MUSE account and return a bearer token

get.description: Machine-readable export of everything MUSE stores about the user.

schema.title: Response Export Data Api V1 Me Export Get

delete.description: Permanently delete the account and all user-owned data (cascade).

get.summary: Suggestions from the user's own MUSE search history plus curated seeds

schema.title: Response Get Search History Api V1 History Search Get

post.summary: Plan and assemble an editable playlist draft from verified search results

Attribution.title: Attribution
Attribution.description: Source attribution that clients must display next to provider metadata.

basis.title: Basis
basis.default: Inferred from your activity inside MUSE: saved songs, playlists, searches and feedback. MUSE cannot see what you play in Brave or on YouTube.

TasteProfile.title: TasteProfile
TasteProfile.description:
Inferred from MUSE activity only (saves, playlists, searches, feedback).

This is not playback history: MUSE cannot see what was played in Brave.
